title: FruitFight
description: "Adds fruit trees, berry bushes, fruit armor and tools, and edible fruits with unique effects. Eating a fruit gives its effect for 1.5 minutes; wearing a full matching armor set grants it permanently
body:
Fruit Fight adds a full fruit-themed combat and farming set to Minecraft.  

Grow orange, lemon, mango, cherry, and peach trees, plus strawberry and blueberry bushes, in the world. Harvest the fruits, eat them for short buffs, or craft full netherite-tier tool and armor sets from each fruit.  

Features  
7 fruits with unique food stats and effects  
Full tool sets for every fruit: sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe (netherite stats)  
Full armor sets for every fruit: helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots (netherite stats)  
Special sword abilities on hit (for example fire, poison, slow, or regeneration)  
Trees and berry bushes with world generation, saplings, logs, and leaves  
Fruit Fight creative tab with every item in one place  
Fruit effects  
Eating a fruit gives its effect for 1.5 minutes. Wearing a full matching armor set grants that effect permanently.  

Orange  
Regeneration + Saturation  
Lemon  
Speed  
Mango  
Fire Resistance + Absorption  
Cherry  
Regeneration II  
Peach  
Resistance  
Strawberry  
Strength  
Blueberry  
Night Vision  
Requirements  
Minecraft 1.21.11  
Fabric Loader  
Fabric API  
Craft tools and armor with fruit and sticks (tools) or fruit alone (armor). Repair gear with the matching fruit.
